pack.name: Emblem and Identity Motifs
pack.target_tools: Midjourney v6/v7 --style raw and Flux.1 pro for backplates and textures; Nano Banana / Gemini image editing and Photoshop for compositing the real emblem onto them; Google Flow / Veo 3 or Runway for the animated reveal; Illustrator or Figma for the final favicon and card typesetting.
pack.critical_notice:
READ THIS BEFORE GENERATING ANYTHING IN THIS PACK.
The TEAM VILLAIN emblem — the brush-ring mark — ALREADY EXISTS as finished artwork. It lives at assets/team-villain.png and is also embedded as an SVG symbol (#emblem) inside index.html. Image generators must NOT be asked to draw it, redraw it, reinterpret it, "improve" it, or invent a logo. Every prompt in this pack produces a BACKPLATE, a SURFACE, a TEXTURE, or a LIGHTING TREATMENT. The real emblem is composited on top afterwards, in Photoshop, Figma, After Effects, or by an image-editing model given the actual PNG as an input layer.
Practical consequence for every prompt below: the area where the emblem will sit is described as empty, clean and unbroken. If a generated backplate has detail exactly where the mark goes, it is unusable. Every negative prompt in this pack therefore includes logo, emblem, symbol, crest, monogram, ring, circle mark, and typography.
Where a prompt says "leave a clean area", that is not a suggestion — it is the deliverable.

compositing_recipes.recipe: Place the emblem PNG over the backplate. Set the layer to Overlay or Soft Light at 60-80%, then add a second copy set to Normal, clipped to a gold gradient (#8A6F3C to #C8A96A to #EDE7DC and back). Add Bevel and Emboss at 2-3px with a soft 120-degree light to match the plate's light direction. Finish with a 1px inner shadow to seat it into the material.
Emblem as a displacement map on the backplate, plus a duplicate layer at Multiply 40% offset 1px toward the light and a Screen 25% copy offset 1px away. Reads as pressed in, not printed on.
Use the emblem as a luminosity mask over a warm gold gradient, then blur a duplicate by 20-40px underneath at 40% for halation. Best over the smoke and haze backplates.

asset.title: Brush-Ring Backplate — black marble
asset.placement: Backplate for the emblem on section dividers, deck covers, merch mockups, member cards.
asset.prompt: A photograph of a square slab of honed black marble, filling the frame edge to edge, shot straight down. The stone is deep void black with fine bone-white and faint aged-gold veining running diagonally through the outer edges of the frame only; the central circular area of the slab, roughly 60% of the width, is a clean, uninterrupted, unveined field of black stone with a soft matte finish and no markings whatsoever. One warm practical light rakes across from the upper left at a shallow angle, revealing the stone's microscopic surface texture, a whisper of dust, and a gentle falloff to near-black at the lower right. No object sits on the stone. No engraving, no carving, no symbol, no lettering. Extremely subtle, low contrast, textural. Shot on 35mm, 85mm macro, tungsten-balanced motion picture negative; T4 for even sharpness across the surface; single warm practical light source, deep crushed blacks with retained shadow detail, subtle halation on the veining; desaturated near-monochrome palette of void black #050505, bone white #EDE7DC and aged gold #C8A96A; fine organic film grain, print-film color science; material study, austere, expensive. --style raw --ar 1:1

asset.title: Gold Foil Emboss — bone paper backplate
asset.placement: Backplate for the foil-stamped emblem treatment: letterhead, member card front, print collateral, deck covers.
asset.prompt: A photograph, extreme macro, of a square of heavy uncoated cotton paper in warm bone white, filling the frame, shot straight down. The paper's deckle tooth and fibre are clearly visible as raking texture; there is a faint pressed impression in the centre — a shallow blind deboss with no shape or design inside it, just a clean recessed field of paper about 60% of the frame width, its edges catching a hairline of shadow and a hairline of light. One warm practical rakes hard from the left at a very shallow angle, so the surface fibre reads in relief and the paper falls off to a soft shadow at the right edge. A single loose fibre and a mote of dust on the surface. No printing, no foil, no mark, no lettering of any kind. Shot on 35mm, 100mm macro, tungsten-balanced motion picture negative; T5.6, tack sharp across the surface; single warm practical light source, deep shadow at the falloff edge, subtle halation on the brightest fibre; desaturated palette of bone white #EDE7DC and smoke #1A1815 with warm gold #C8A96A only in the light; material study, austere, expensive, tactile. --style raw --ar 1:1

asset.title: Wax Seal — blank aged-gold wax on black
asset.placement: Seal motif: invitation closures, the site's seal element, email sign-offs, envelope mockups.
asset.prompt: A photograph, macro, of a single blob of freshly pressed sealing wax on black paper, dead centre in the frame. The wax is aged gold — a dull, metallic, slightly tarnished gold with dark bronze pooling in its low points, not shiny yellow. It has irregular organic edges where it spread and cooled, a slight rim of squeeze-out, one small air bubble, and a completely smooth, flat, blank pressed face in the middle with no design, no crest, no letters, no impression of any kind. One warm practical from the upper left catches the wax's raised rim and the metallic flecks in it, leaving the pressed face slightly darker and the black paper around it falling away into pure black. A tiny fragment of loose wax sits beside it. Shallow focus with only the near edge of the seal critically sharp. Shot on 35mm, 100mm macro, tungsten-balanced motion picture negative; T2.8, extremely shallow depth of field, oval bokeh; single warm practical light source, deep crushed blacks, subtle halation on the metallic flecks; desaturated near-monochrome palette of void black #050505, aged gold #C8A96A and deep bronze #8A6F3C; heavy negative space; fine organic film grain, print-film color science; still-life, ceremonial, expensive. --style raw --ar 1:1

asset.title: Emblem Reveal — animated backplate
asset.placement: Logo-reveal sting for video intros, social outros, and the site's seal animation. The real emblem is keyed in over this in After Effects.
asset.prompt: A single continuous locked-off shot in a black void. Thick smoke and fine gold particulate hang almost motionless in the frame, lit from behind by a single warm aged-gold source that is slowly, steadily rising in intensity over four seconds — beginning as almost nothing, ending as a soft, wide, centred bloom of warm light diffusing through the haze, its edges feathering into black at the corners of the frame. As the light builds, the smoke drifts apart in slow motion and the centre of the frame CLEARS, becoming an open, uncluttered, evenly glowing field with no smoke detail and no shape in it, while wisps and filaments remain at the outer edges. A few embers rise slowly through the left of the frame. No object, no figure, no symbol, no shape forms in the smoke — the centre must end completely clean. The camera does not move at all. Slow motion, roughly 50% speed. Shot on 35mm anamorphic with a long lens, tungsten-balanced motion picture negative; T2.0, shallow depth of field; deep crushed blacks with retained shadow detail, volumetric haze, subtle halation on the gold; desaturated near-monochrome palette of void black #050505 and aged gold #C8A96A; abstract, ceremonial, expensive. No on-screen text, no titles, no audio narration.

asset.title: Favicon and Social Avatar Backplate
asset.placement: Backplate behind the emblem for favicon (32px, 180px), social avatars (Instagram, X, LinkedIn), and any small circular crop.
asset.prompt: A photograph, straight down, of a square of black hand-finished surface that fills the frame — a dark bronze-black metal plate with an extremely fine brushed grain and a faint aged patina, almost featureless. A single warm practical enters from the upper left at a very shallow angle, producing a soft, wide, gentle gradient of aged-gold sheen across the upper-left quadrant that falls to pure void black in the lower right. There is nothing on the surface: no engraving, no mark, no symbol, no lettering, no scratches, no branding. The gradient must be smooth and low contrast enough to survive being scaled down to 32 pixels — no fine detail, no busy texture, no hotspot. Shot on 35mm, 100mm macro, tungsten-balanced motion picture negative; T5.6, evenly sharp; single warm practical light source, deep crushed blacks; desaturated palette of void black #050505, deep bronze #8A6F3C and aged gold #C8A96A; minimal, austere, expensive. --style raw --ar 1:1

asset.title: The Invitation Card
asset.placement: Invitation mockup for social, email headers, and the audience/apply section. The card face is left blank for the emblem and typeset copy.
asset.prompt: A photograph. A single heavy card of black cotton paper with a bevelled, gilt-painted edge lies at a slight angle on a black marble surface in near-darkness, shot from a low three-quarter angle so the card recedes slightly. The card face is completely blank — deep matte black, no printing, no design, no lettering, no mark of any kind — but its surface texture and the aged-gold gilding along its bevelled edge are clearly rendered. Beside it lies a torn black envelope with a broken blob of aged-gold sealing wax, and a single unlit candle stub. One warm practical from the extreme upper left rakes across the scene, igniting the gilt edge as a thin bright line, catching the wax, and falling away to pure black across the rest of the frame. Fine dust in the light. Heavy negative space above and to the right. Shallow focus, only the near edge of the card critically sharp. Shot on 35mm anamorphic, 85mm, tungsten-balanced motion picture negative pushed one stop; T2.8, shallow depth of field, oval bokeh; single warm practical light source, deep crushed blacks with retained shadow detail, subtle halation on the gilt edge; desaturated near-monochrome palette of void black #050505, aged gold #C8A96A and deep bronze #8A6F3C; fine organic film grain, print-film color science; still-life, ceremonial, secretive, expensive. --style raw --ar 4:5
